description: How much grout a tile job takes from the tile size, joint width, joint depth and area, in pounds and bags. The grout density is editable so you can match your product. Formula: Each tile plus its joint is a (L + J) × (W + J) module, of which J × (L + W + J) is joint. Joint share = J(L + W + J) ÷ ((L + J)(W + J)). Grout volume (cu ft) = area × joint share × depth(in) ÷ 12; pounds = volume × density × (1 + waste); bags = ⌈pounds ÷ bag size⌉.

density_lb_cf.description: Grout weight per cubic foot of joint (from your grout data sheet; ~100 sanded, ~85 unsanded) (lb/cu ft); default 100
